thread:
anna: New lightweight launch post ready for review 150-300 words + benchmark sidebar. Need legal quick-pass, growth for HubSpot mapping, and design for hero crop. Planning publish Fri AM. Draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/may-draft (comments inline)

mike: thanks anna 1. For HubSpot, funnel: "Launch Webinar - Redwood Inference" list. Add tag: launch:webinar_interest. Also want hidden field campaign_id=launch_may_2024 on the reg form.

anna: added campaign_id and tag suggestions to the sheet.

jamal: perf note 11 please call out test rig in the benchmark note. Right now it says "our tests" which is vague. Suggest: "tests run on Dedicated N4x2, 8k context, median of 3 runs".

anna: done 11 added exact config and a link to the perf spreadsheet.

leo: legal quick note 11 can't use "cheaper than X" without comparative citation. Use "lower unit cost in our tests (see methodology)" and include the methodology link. Also remove any wording that sounds like an SLA for hosted.

anna: tweaked to "lower unit cost in our tests (see methodology)" and replaced any hosted SLA phrasing. pushed new draft.

sarah: design: hero should be the latency vs cost curve, 1200x630. I'll drop a cropped PNG in Figma and add a small inset mock of the CTA button labeled "Reserve a spot".

mike: UTMs for paid promo (finalized):

    utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign=launch_may_2024&utm_term=llm_inference

mike: please ensure any shortlinks include the utm params on the webinar CTA.

anna: will do. Also switching CTA copy from "Sign up" to "Reserve a spot" per Sarah.

jamal: content nit: in the paragraph about routing, add one sentence clarifying fallbacks: "Requests automatically fall back to compatible model variants when primary capacity is unavailable (configurable per route)." keeps expectations clear.

anna: added that sentence.

leo: one more legal tweak 11 replace "zero downtime" with "graceful degradation and automatic fallback policies".

anna: replaced.

mike: inbound routing rules for owner assignment: if company_size >= 500 -> owner = Enterprise AE queue; else owner = SDR queue. Also set contact property first_touch_campaign=launch_may_2024.

anna: mapping added to the lead sheet. pushed an example webhook payload for engineering to review.

publish-bot: preflight scheduled -> 2024-05-17T15:00:00Z. Automated checks: broken links, image dims, utm on CTA, hs mapping.

sarah: small copy tweak: hero CTA microcopy to read "Reserve your spot" (plural). Feels friendlier.

mike: growth approves mapping and utm names. :white_check_mark:

jamal: product sign-off on technical claims. :thumbsup:
